title: Maxmin Is At Most Minmax
body_html:
Maxmin Is At Most Minmax

For every zero-sum game, $\underline v \le \overline v$.
proof_html:
For every pair $(i,j)$, $$ \inf_{j' \in J} g(i,j') \le g(i,j) \le \sup_{i' \in I} g(i',j). $$ Taking the supremum over $i$ on the left and the infimum over $j$ on the right gives $\underline v \le \overline v$. $\square$

References

  • [MFoGT, Lemma 2.2.4] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Weak duality for maxmin and minmax.
